fields.label: Nationality or citizenship
fields.hint: Enter your current nationality as printed on your passport's details page.

fields.label: ID No. issued to you by your government
fields.hint: Enter your government-issued national identity number (e.g., Aadhaar card number for Indian citizens, Social Security Number for US citizens, Resident Identity Card number). Write 'N/A' if your country does not issue one.
fields.warning: Do not enter your passport number here. This must be your government-issued ID card number.

fields.label: Given and middle names (as shown in passport)
fields.hint: Enter your first name and middle name(s) exactly as they appear in the machine-readable zone or details page of your passport.

fields.label: Surname (as shown in passport)
fields.hint: Enter your family name or surname exactly as shown in your passport.

fields.label: Place of birth
fields.hint: Enter the city and state/province/country where you were born, matching the place of birth printed in your passport.

fields.label: Former and/or other nationalities or citizenships
fields.hint: If you hold dual nationality or previously held another citizenship (e.g., prior to naturalization), list them here. If you have never changed your nationality, write 'N/A'.

fields.label: Certificate of Eligibility No.
fields.hint: Leave blank or write 'N/A'. A Certificate of Eligibility (COE) is only issued by Japanese Immigration for long-term residency (work, study, spouse). It is NOT required for a standard tourist or short-term visitor visa.
fields.warning: Standard tourist visa applicants do not have a Certificate of Eligibility. Entering a random number here will cause your application to be rejected.

fields.label: Tel.
fields.hint: Enter your primary telephone number, including country and area codes.

fields.label: Mobile No.
fields.hint: Enter your mobile phone number, including country code.

fields.label: Address
fields.hint: Enter your current residential address where you reside. This must match the address proof you submit (e.g., utility bill, rent agreement).
fields.example: Flat 402, Sunrise Apartments, Sector 15, Rohini, New Delhi, 110089, India

fields.label: Other names (including any other names you are or have been known by)
fields.hint: Enter any former names, maiden names (prior to marriage), aliases, or alternative spellings. If you have never used any other names, write 'N/A'.

fields.label: E-Mail
fields.hint: Enter your primary personal email address where you can receive status updates.

fields.label: Marital status
fields.hint: Select your current legal marital status.

fields.label: Date of expiry
fields.hint: Enter the expiration date of your passport in DD/MM/YYYY format.
fields.warning: Your passport must have at least 6 months of validity remaining from the date of your arrival in Japan.

fields.label: Issuing authority
fields.hint: Enter the authority that issued your passport exactly as printed on the details page (e.g., 'Ministry of External Affairs', 'US Department of State', 'IPS').

fields.label: Passport No.
fields.hint: Enter your passport number exactly as shown on the details page, including letters and numbers.

fields.label: Date of issue
fields.hint: Enter the date your passport was issued in DD/MM/YYYY format.

fields.label: Place of issue
fields.hint: Enter the city or state where your passport was issued, as stated in your passport.

fields.label: Category of passport
fields.hint: Select the type of passport you hold. Most tourists travel on an 'Ordinary' passport.

fields.label: Dates and duration of previous stays in Japan
fields.hint: List all your previous trips to Japan, specifying the exact start/end dates and the duration (e.g., '10/05/2024 to 18/05/2024 (9 days)'). If you have never visited Japan before, write 'N/A'.
fields.warning: Be precise and match the entry/exit stamps in your passport. Discrepancies may delay processing.

fields.label: Date of arrival in Japan
fields.hint: Enter your planned date of arrival in Japan in DD/MM/YYYY format.

fields.label: Port of entry into Japan
fields.hint: Enter the airport or seaport where you will first land and clear customs in Japan (e.g., Narita, Haneda, Kansai).

fields.label: Name of ship or airline
fields.hint: Enter the airline code and flight number of your arrival flight into Japan. If arriving by cruise, enter the ship's name. If flight details are not finalized, enter the planned flight.

fields.label: Purpose of visit to Japan/Status of residence
fields.hint: Enter the reason for your travel. For a tourist visa, write 'Temporary Visitor' or 'Tourism'. Do not write 'Business' or 'Work' unless you hold supporting documentation.

fields.label: Intended length of stay in Japan
fields.hint: Enter the total number of days you plan to spend in Japan from arrival to departure.

fields.label: Hotel / Accommodation Address
fields.hint: Enter the complete physical address of your hotel, hostel, or host in Japan where you will stay first.

fields.label: Hotel / Accommodation Telephone
fields.hint: Enter the contact phone number of the hotel or host in Japan, including the country code (+81).

fields.label: Hotel / Accommodation Name
fields.hint: Enter the name of the hotel, hostel, or person you will stay with first in Japan. This must match the accommodation listed in your schedule of stay.
fields.warning: Ensure this matches the accommodation voucher or itinerary submitted with your application.

fields.label: Employer / School Address
fields.hint: Enter the complete address of your current employer, business, or school. Write 'N/A' if you are unemployed, retired, or a homemaker.
fields.example: 123 Business Bay, Phase 2, Electronic City, Bengaluru, 560100, India

fields.label: Employer / School Telephone
fields.hint: Enter the phone number of your current employer, business, or school. Write 'N/A' if not applicable.

fields.label: Employer / School Name
fields.hint: Enter the name of your current employer, company, or school. If you are unemployed, retired, or a homemaker, write 'N/A'.

fields.label: Partner's or Parent's Profession/Occupation
fields.hint: Enter the profession/occupation of your spouse or partner. If you are a minor (under 18), enter your parent's occupation. If not applicable, write 'N/A'.

fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.hint: Enter the guarantor's date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format. Write 'N/A' if you do not have a guarantor.

fields.label: Sex
fields.hint: Select the sex of your guarantor. Write 'N/A' or select option if applicable. Independent tourists with no guarantor can skip or write 'N/A'.

fields.label: Address
fields.hint: Enter the complete residential or business address of the guarantor in Japan. Write 'N/A' if you are traveling independently as a self-funded tourist.

fields.label: Name
fields.hint: Enter the full name of the guarantor in Japan. For independent tourists traveling with hotel bookings, write 'N/A'.
fields.warning: If you are traveling as a standard self-funded tourist, you do not need a guarantor. Simply write 'N/A'.

fields.label: Tel.
fields.hint: Enter the telephone number of the guarantor. Write 'N/A' if you do not have a guarantor.

fields.label: Relationship to Applicant
fields.hint: Enter the guarantor's relationship to you (e.g., Friend, Relative, Employer). Write 'N/A' if you do not have a guarantor.

fields.label: Nationality & Immigration Status
fields.hint: Enter the guarantor's nationality and their current residency/visa status in Japan (e.g., 'Japanese' or 'Permanent Resident'). Write 'N/A' if you do not have a guarantor.

fields.label: Profession / Occupation & Position
fields.hint: Enter the guarantor's job title or occupation. Write 'N/A' if you do not have a guarantor.

fields.label: Current Profession / Occupation & Position
fields.hint: Enter the inviter's job title or occupation. If the inviter is the same as the guarantor, write 'Same as above'. If you do not have an inviter, write 'N/A'.

fields.label: Address
fields.hint: Enter the complete address of the inviter in Japan. Write 'Same as above' or 'N/A' as applicable.

fields.label: Name
fields.hint: Enter the full name of the inviting person in Japan. Write 'Same as above' if the inviter is the same as the guarantor, or 'N/A' if you do not have an inviter.
fields.warning: If you are traveling as a standard self-funded tourist, you do not need an inviter. Simply write 'N/A'.

fields.label: Tel.
fields.hint: Enter the telephone number of the inviter. Write 'Same as above' or 'N/A' as applicable.

fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.hint: Enter the inviter's date of birth. Write 'Same as above' or 'N/A' as applicable.

fields.label: Relationship to Applicant
fields.hint: Enter the inviter's relationship to you. Write 'Same as above' or 'N/A' as applicable.

fields.label: Profession / Occupation & Position
fields.hint: Enter the inviter's job title or occupation. Write 'Same as above' or 'N/A' as applicable.

fields.label: Nationality & Immigration Status
fields.hint: Enter the inviter's nationality and residency/visa status in Japan. Write 'Same as above' or 'N/A' as applicable.

fields.label: Sex
fields.hint: Select the sex of your inviter. Write 'Same as above' or 'N/A' as applicable.

fields.label: Remarks / Special Circumstances
fields.hint: Use this field to provide details for any 'Yes' answers to the questionnaire below, to request multiple entries (explain why you need them), or to state any other special circumstances (e.g. medical treatments). Write 'N/A' if none.

fields.label: Date of Application
fields.hint: Enter the date you submit or sign the application form (DD/MM/YYYY).

fields.label: Have you ever been convicted of a crime or offence in any country?
fields.hint: Select 'Yes' or 'No'. If Yes, details must be entered in the Remarks section.
fields.warning: You must answer this question truthfully. Providing false declarations can lead to visa refusal, visa cancellation, and a travel ban to Japan.

fields.label: Have you ever been sentenced to imprisonment for 1 year or more in any country?
fields.hint: Select 'Yes' or 'No'. This includes suspended sentences.
fields.warning: You must disclose all sentences of 1 year or more, even if they were suspended or not served. False declarations will result in denial of entry.

fields.label: Have you ever been deported or removed from Japan or any country for overstaying your visa or violating any law or regulation?
fields.hint: Select 'Yes' or 'No'. Includes deportation from any country, not just Japan.
fields.warning: Past visa overstays or deportations must be declared. Concealment of prior deportation is a serious offense that can bar you from Japan permanently.

fields.label: Have you ever been convicted and sentenced for a drug offence in any country in violation of law concerning narcotics, marijuana, opium, stimulants or psychotropic substances?
fields.hint: Select 'Yes' or 'No'. Any drug conviction, regardless of severity, must be declared.
fields.warning: Japan has extremely strict drug laws. Declaring a drug offense will result in close scrutiny and is a common ground for permanent visa denial.

fields.label: Have you ever engaged in prostitution, or in the intermediation or solicitation of a prostitute for other persons, or in the provision of a place for prostitution, or any other activity directly connected to prostitution?
fields.hint: Select 'Yes' or 'No'.
fields.warning: Truthful disclosure is required. False statements are grounds for visa denial and potential immigration penalties.

fields.label: Have you ever committed trafficking in persons or incited or aided another to commit such an offence?
fields.hint: Select 'Yes' or 'No'.
fields.warning: Truthful disclosure is required. Human trafficking is a serious offense under Japanese law.
